assertion_audit: tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:205-206 fail when the base read is invalid or has no normal-form cells; these conditions establish that the synthetic fixture reaches the geometry branch.

tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:238 and :241 fail when a perturbed fresh read is invalid or its observed column has zero magnitude; the finite-difference instrument demonstrably sees the nonzero column reported in column-motion.log.

tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:247 compares the assembled column against a separately evaluated full fresh-read residual and fails when geometry response is removed, as geometry-current-negative.log shows at 0.135.
tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:248 fails if the fresh and frozen columns collapse together; it is a branch-exercise check and alone does not prove fresh-read accuracy.

tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:268-270 fail if the oracle ratios exceed 1e-10, while :271 compares returned roots with independently supplied fixture roots and :272 fails a seed echo because the fixture seeds are displaced.
tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:280-282 fail if an intentionally displaced read is accepted as accurate, giving the ratio checks a negative case.
tests/test_bank_newton_converge.py:291-295 fail if the fresh solve does not converge to 1e-10 or misses the analytic axis, saddle, or boundary budgets.
